name: BrainGame
description: A collection of spatial reasoning and cognitive logic puzzle games. Features SpinMatrix (rotate sub-grids), SphereShift (shift rows/columns with blind mode), and HexLogic (hexagonal rotation puzzles).

games.name: SpinMatrix
games.description: Rotate 2x2 sub-grids to match the target pattern

games.name: SphereShift
games.description: Shift rows and columns of spheres to align colors
